dogecoin.text:
Start with identity.
Your memecoin needs:

• A strong name

• A unique personality

• A story people relate to or laugh at

Example: $DOGE had the Shiba + chaotic energy.
What’s your coin’s vibe?

#Cryptobranding #MemeMeta

Examples:

• $DOGE → Payment adoption (Dallas Mavericks, Tesla merch)

• $BONK on Solana → NFTs, rewards, partnerships

• Other meme projects → Launchpads, games, loyalty clubs

What starts as a joke can turn into an ecosystem.

#FromMemeToMovement

Step 1: Give your coin a personality
Is it the underdog?
The revenge-seeker?
The cosmic meme from another planet?
Create a character or symbol people can rally behind — like $DOGE the Shiba or $PEPE the frog.

#CryptoBranding #Web3Storytelling
